Internal SOP — Retail Savings & Current Account Opening
1. Objective & Application
Standard operating procedure for verifying retail customer applications at branch counters and digital
channels.
2. Verification Steps
Staff must verify original OVDs against submitted copies, perform In-Person Verification (IPV) or Video
KYC (V-CIP), and record customer consent.
3. Risk Scoring & System Entry
Assign initial risk rating (Low/Medium/High) in core banking based on customer profile, occupation, and
geographic location.
